visual_logic.composition: A professional 2x2 grid. The 3D rendering highlights the 'milky' texture of the workers versus the 'polished wood' texture of the soldiers.
visual_logic.top_left_birth: The Royal Chamber. A large, bloated Queen termite is surrounded by tiny, attentive workers. Dozens of small, pearl-like eggs are being moved by workers into nursery side-chambers. The atmosphere is calm and humid.
visual_logic.top_right_dining: A group of workers are seen vibrating their heads as they chew through a thick fiber of ancient wood. One worker is sharing a drop of liquid (trophallaxis) with another, showing their social feeding behavior.
visual_logic.bottom_left_sleeping: A 'resting gallery' where hundreds of termites are packed closely together, perfectly still, to conserve moisture and body heat during the cold desert night. Their antennae are lowered and overlapping.
visual_logic.bottom_right_activity: Defense! An 'Araripesuchus' (dog-croc) snout is poking into a break in the log. The 'Soldier' termites have rushed to the front, clicking their oversized, dark mandibles in a defensive line to protect the workers fleeing behind them.
visual_logic.rendering_notes: The soldiers' heads should have a high-gloss, 'lacquered' finish to distinguish them as the 'armor' of the colony. Use subsurface scattering on the workers to make them look soft and organic.
